articles.title: IIT Delhi Open House 2026 draws 4,500 visitors, showcases over 500 research presentations
articles.summary: IIT Delhi Open House 2026: IIT Delhi organised the 19th edition of its Open House on October 31, 2026, showcasing more than 500 technological presentations across 10 research themes. The event featured over 100 prototype demonstrations, 225 research posters, 80 laboratory demonstrations and more than 90 student research talks.

articles.title: UPTET 2026: Allahabad High Court orders exclusion of two questions, directs UPESSC to revise scores for all candidates
articles.summary: The Allahabad High Court has directed UPESSC to remove two disputed questions from the UPTET 2026 evaluation and recalculate scores based on 148 questions. The court has extended the relief to all similarly placed candidates, not just the petitioners, while clarifying that revised eligibility will not guarantee appointment in future teacher recruitment exercises..

articles.title: WBCHSE semester system under review: Will West Bengal bring back annual Class 11 and 12 exams?
articles.summary: The West Bengal Council of Higher Secondary Education (WBCHSE) is reviewing concerns surrounding the four-semester examination system for Classes 11 and 12. Teachers and school heads have flagged limited classroom time, syllabus completion challenges and increased examination workload.

articles.title: UP Special TET admit card 2026 released at upessc.up.gov.in: Direct link to download hall tickets here
articles.summary: The Uttar Pradesh Education Service Selection Commission has released the UP Special TET admit card 2026 for candidates appearing in the examination on November 3. The hall ticket can be downloaded from the official UPESSC website.

articles.title: Song Ji Ho and Kim So Ri are officially married
articles.summary: Kim So Ri and Song Ji Ho officially married on October 23, 2026, after several years of dating. Their wedding took place outdoors at Samcheongak in Seoul, surrounded by family and friends.

articles.title: Nagarjuna announces new release date for ‘Itlu Arjuna’
articles.summary: Actors Anish and Anaswara Rajan will lead in the upcoming Telugu movie Itlu Arjuna, directed by Mahesh Uppala. Set to hit theaters on November 13, 2026, the film promises a heartfelt romantic narrative, with Anish portraying a character overcoming speech and hearing challenges.

articles.title: ‘Irumudi’ makers receive labour department notice over child actor
articles.summary: The Telangana labour department has issued a notice regarding concerns about Baby Nakshathra's participation in the shooting and promotional events for 'Irumudi'. The filmmakers are set to meet the department on November 4 to discuss issues such as work hours, payment, and safety protocols for the young actor.

articles.title: Ritika Singh exposes fake Facebook account using her name
articles.summary: Ritika Singh alerted her followers about a fraudulent Facebook page operating under her name. The page charges Rs 400 monthly subscriptions while falsely claiming to represent her.
